content: The expectation is that the student embeddings can be learned effectively this way from the teacher embeddings as well as model parameters $\theta _{t}$. Note that we perform dual training only for the teacher model inputs: the student model receives words segmented exclusively using the student vocabulary. Also, during masked language modeling, the model uses different softmax layers for the teacher and the student vocabularies depending on which one was used to segment the word in question.
